caption: The drawing depicts a single table with a rectangular top that has chamfered corners. The table is rendered in shades of reddish-brown, resembling polished wood grain, with darker and lighter areas to suggest reflections and depth. The tabletop rests on a single, ornate central pedestal that is decorated with swirling patterns and carved details in a similar reddish-brown color. The pedestal transitions into a base with four curved legs, each ending in a claw-shaped foot capped with what appears to be a gold or brass shoe. The table sits on a blank, off-white or light beige background, and there is a thin border drawn around the edges of the paper. The name “Erwin Schwabe” is written in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Mahogany Tilt-top Table
